title: The More Popular, The Harder to Forget: Adaptive Popularity for LLM Unlearning
abstract: arXiv:2608.14229v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Popular facts are memorised more deeply during pretraining and resist removal longer than rare ones, yet existing LLM unlearning methods apply uniform gradient pressure regardless of training-data frequency. We propose the AdaPop (Adaptive Popularity) method, which combines local token confidence with a per-fact popularity-dependent exponent derived from an external proxy (e.g., Wikidata sitelinks, LLM-as-Judge), and automates the forget-retain balance via a dual-ascent controller that adjusts the retain penalty each epoch. Across three model families and two benchmarks, AdaPop leaks ~5x less forgotten content than competing methods under paraphrased queries and ~1.6x less under adversarial reformulations. We support our analysis with internal metrics: under our method, forget-set hidden states move further from the pre-unlearning model's states than under other methods, while retain-set representations remain close.

translated_title: 越流行越难遗忘：面向大语言模型遗忘的自适应流行度方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14229v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：在预训练过程中，流行事实被记忆得更深，且比稀有事实更难以被移除，然而现有的LLM遗忘方法无论训练数据频率如何，都采用统一的梯度压力。我们提出了AdaPop（自适应流行度）方法，该方法将局部令牌置信度与基于外部代理（如Wikidata站点链接、LLM作为裁判）得出的每事实流行度依赖指数相结合，并通过一个双上升控制器自动调整遗忘-保留平衡，该控制器在每个训练周期调整保留惩罚。在三个模型家族和两个基准测试中，AdaPop在释义查询下的遗忘内容泄漏量比竞争方法少约5倍，在对抗性改写下少约1.6倍。我们用内部指标支持我们的分析：在我们的方法下，遗忘集的隐藏状态比在其他方法下更远离预遗忘模型的隐藏状态，而保留集的表示保持接近。
tldr: AdaPop方法通过引入基于外部代理的流行度依赖指数和双上升控制器，实现了对大语言模型中不同流行度事实的自适应遗忘，显著降低了遗忘内容在释义和对抗性查询下的泄漏。
en_tdlr: AdaPop introduces a popularity-dependent exponent and dual-ascent controller for adaptive unlearning in LLMs, reducing forgotten content leakage by ~5x under paraphrased queries and ~1.6x under adversarial reformulations.
